title: Is PayPal Available in Sri Lanka?
summary: Is PayPal available in Sri Lanka? Yes. See which banks support receiving and withdrawals, which account to use, and fees on a $1,000 payment.

The[PayPal bank-partner page](https://www.paypal.com/lk/business/banking-partners) lists personal receiving and withdrawals as live at both banks. For a freelancer opening an account today, **personal is the clear route** : it can receive payment for goods and services. You don’t need to wait for new business signup to launch.


Use a personal PayPal account for the ComBank route. PayPal’s partner page allows existing business accounts to link to retail or sole-trader accounts at ComBank and Sampath, but[ComBank’s own FAQ](https://www.combank.lk/info/215) limits its service to personal PayPal accounts. New business signup, invoicing and Checkout remain pending.


## **What changed in May 2026?**


**Date**


**What changed**


**What it means**


15 May 2026


[PayPal announced the Sri Lanka expansion.](https://www.onlanka.com/news/paypal-expands-services-in-sri-lanka.html)


The expansion was announced; the banks and features did not all go live at once.


28 May 2026


[ComBank withdrawals were reported live.](https://mawratanews.lk/business/commercial-bank-now-brings-paypal-linked-withdrawals-for-customers/)


Customers could move PayPal funds into an LKR bank account.


9 September 2026


[PayPal lists receiving and withdrawals live at ComBank and Sampath.](https://www.paypal.com/lk/business/banking-partners)


Receiving and withdrawals are available at both banks; Bank of Ceylon is still coming soon.


The older advice that Sri Lanka is completely send-only is out of date. The current service lets you receive an overseas client’s payment through a linked bank account.


## Can Sri Lankans receive money through PayPal?


**Yes.** Link your Sri Lanka-registered PayPal account through Commercial Bank or Sampath, then use it to receive payments from clients abroad.


The payer must be outside Sri Lanka. The bank-partner service doesn’t accept a payment from another Sri Lankan PayPal account.


A personal account can receive payment for freelance work. PayPal still charges its commercial receiving fee on that payment.


Give the client the email address on your connected PayPal account. Only available funds can be withdrawn; pending payments stay in PayPal until released.


## Which banks support PayPal in Sri Lanka?


**Commercial Bank and Sampath are live.** At ComBank, the connection runs through the ComBank Digital mobile app. You need a savings or current account, a mobile number registered with the bank, and the same email address and date of birth on both accounts.


At Sampath, open PayPal in the bank dashboard and submit the signup or linking application. After the bank sends its verification notification, return to PayPal in the dashboard to complete the connection.


Linking a card for shopping won’t turn on receiving. The[Sri Lanka PayPal account guide](https://www.elevatepay.co/blog/open-paypal-account-sri-lanka) walks through the bank connection, including the exact ComBank button labels.


You can link more than one partner bank. PayPal requires at least one connection to receive money, and you must connect each bank you want to withdraw through.


## How to withdraw PayPal to Commercial Bank


In the ComBank Digital mobile app, follow the bank’s[withdrawal instructions](https://www.combank.lk/info/215) :


1.


Open My Portfolio, tap your PayPal account, then tap **Withdraw** .


2.


Select your destination LKR account and enter the USD amount.


3.


Accept the terms and tap **Submit** . The next screen shows the exchange rate and approximate LKR amount.


4.


Enter the OTP and confirm the withdrawal, then download the cyber receipt.


ComBank says the money arrives instantly after successful authorization. Its FAQ gives a **$3.50 minimum withdrawal** and limits withdrawals to personal LKR accounts.


Money on hold in PayPal can’t be withdrawn yet. A completed bank link doesn’t release that hold.


## What does PayPal cost in Sri Lanka?


ComBank’s[PayPal service page](https://www.combank.lk/services/paypal) states: “All fees and charges will be displayed before you confirm the transaction (USD 3.00 + 3% of the transaction Value)”. For a new **$1,000 overseas client payment** , our estimate leaves **LKR 300,079** after PayPal’s receiving fee and ComBank’s published withdrawal fee, using ComBank’s 9 September TT buying rate. The[Sri Lanka fees guide](https://www.elevatepay.co/blog/paypal-fees-sri-lanka) shows the calculation and the $100–$2,000 examples.


### PayPal vs Elevate Pay on a $1,000 client payment


If your client can pay by ACH, we charge $0 to receive USD and $1.50 to transfer up to $5,000 to your Sri Lankan bank. Here’s an estimate of what you receive after fees with Elevate Pay and PayPal.

ComBank’s TT rate is the reference for this estimate. Separate sender charges are excluded.


## Which route fits freelance income?


**Use PayPal when the client wants to pay through PayPal.** The bank connection now gives Sri Lankan freelancers a local withdrawal route.


For a client who can pay by ACH, use your Elevate Pay USD receiving details. On the $1,000 example, you keep about LKR 27,669 more.[Open your Elevate Pay account in Sri Lanka](https://www.elevatepay.co/blog/open-elevate-pay-account-sri-lanka) , then follow our[local-bank transfer steps](https://www.elevatepay.co/learn/elevate-pay-to-local-bank) .


Wise doesn’t offer USD account details to residents with a Sri Lankan address, according to its[account-details rules](https://wise.com/help/articles/2810318/can-i-get-usd-account-details) . A client abroad can still use Wise to send money to Sri Lanka.


Compare the other options in[PayPal alternatives in Sri Lanka](https://www.elevatepay.co/blog/paypal-alternatives-sri-lanka) , or see[PayPal vs Elevate Pay](https://www.elevatepay.co/blog/paypal-vs-elevate-pay-sri-lanka) for a closer comparison.


## Frequently asked questions


### Can a personal PayPal account receive freelance payments?


Yes. A personal account linked through ComBank or Sampath can receive overseas goods-and-services payments. PayPal’s commercial receiving fee still applies.


### Can I receive a payment from someone in Sri Lanka?


No. This service receives payments from abroad. It doesn’t enable domestic receiving between Sri Lankan PayPal accounts.


### Can I use PayPal Checkout for my Sri Lankan website?


Not yet. PayPal’s Sri Lanka bank-partner page still lists Checkout and invoicing as coming soon.


### Is Bank of Ceylon available?


Not yet. PayPal still listed Bank of Ceylon as coming soon on 9 September 2026.


### Can I withdraw PayPal in USD at ComBank?


No. ComBank’s FAQ says withdrawals go to a personal LKR account. The bank processes the withdrawal in USD, then converts it to rupees.


## How we checked this


We checked PayPal’s bank-partner features and fees, ComBank’s signup and withdrawal instructions, and ComBank’s dated exchange rate alongside our LKR rate. The PayPal steps follow the bank’s published instructions, and the comparison uses calculated fees and dated public rates.
